title: 1 - Bob Version 1.0
summary: Newly financially secure after selling his software business, Bob Johansson attends The Vortex, a three-day science-fiction convention in Las Vegas, and signs a cryonics agreement. Convention discussions include extraterrestrial life and self-replicating space probes, while conversations with former colleagues and family touch on the breakup he is recovering from. Later, a car bears down on him in a crosswalk; pain, medical voices, and his fading awareness strongly indicate a fatal collision.

introducing.name: Bob's Road Incident
introducing.description: While Bob crosses a Las Vegas street, a car approaches, he experiences sudden pain, and medical and legal voices accompany his fading awareness. The sequence strongly suggests a fatal collision.

introducing.name: Robert Johansson
introducing.current_state: Presumed dead after the road incident.

introducing.name: CryoEterna Inc.
introducing.description: A cryonics provider offering post-death preservation under contract.

introducing.name: InterGator Software
introducing.description: Bob's software company, built around a successful engineering application and sold after attracting a large acquisition offer.
